item.title: [infoq] AI Agent 正在改写 CPU 的价值：当 Token 变成行动，算力竞争不再只是拼 GPU
item.description: Arm's cloud AI solutions architecture director Ravi Malhotra argues that in agentic workloads, CPU performance should no longer be judged mainly by token generation. The CPU has to turn generated tokens into actions such as compiling and testing code, calling tools, hitting databases and isolating sandboxes, while accelerators handle planning. Arm has published an evaluation method covering tool calls, orchestration and end-to-end task execution, developed with Fujitsu, Meta, OpenAI and others.

item.description: QuireKit is an open-source framework for document editors that keeps ProseMirror's document, transaction and collaboration model but replaces the view layer: pagination, line breaking, cursor and selection are computed by its own layout engine and painted with Canvas or SVG, with cross-page tables, headers and footers, and DOCX round-trip. item.title: [github_trending] Nutlope/hallmark
item.description: Hallmark, made by Together AI, is a design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that deals three themes from a 48-theme catalog, then lints the build in a real browser against machine-made tells like eyebrows above headings or one coloured word in a headline. Gates come in tiers: a Floor covering contrast, focus, reduced motion and invented facts that never ships, overridable Reflex defaults, and a fresh-context reviewer with the last word.

item.title: [v2ex] [iOS] iOS 27.2 治不了百度网盘的开屏摇一摇广告
item.description: iOS 27.2 adds a "Restrict Motion Data" switch under Settings, Privacy & Security, Motion & Fitness, which blocks listed apps from reading motion data. One user found that adding Baidu Netdisk to that list still doesn't stop its shake-to-jump splash ad. The working fix lives inside the app: Me, Settings, Privacy & Personalization, Personalization Management, Ad Interest Management, then turn off the splash-screen shake ad.

item.title: [infoq] PostgreSQL 19 发不出来？AI“找茬”太快，人类修Bug的速度跟不上了
item.description: PostgreSQL 19 slipped from October 29 to November 19, with an extra RC2 on November 12, after roughly 8 to 10 significant features were reverted during beta. Core committer and EDB vice president Peter Eisentraut says the cause is not vibe coding but maturing LLM-assisted code review and fuzzing, which surfaced long-tail defects that would otherwise have trickled in over five years. AI raised the effective quality bar faster than humans can fix bugs.

item.title: [infoq] 智源众智 FlagOS 2.2 让前沿模型与多元算力协同演进
item.description: FlagOS 2.2 now bundles nine operator libraries covering 1,454 operators, 890 more than the previous release, and reports roughly 27% overall cross-chip performance gains measured across 10 heterogeneous AI chips and over a thousand operators. In one deployment with GLM-5.3-Flash, existing Ascend 910B hardware served 2.04x its previous logical throughput, with rent-equivalent compute cost running 19.4%–27.6% below comparable commercial API pricing.

It is MIT-licensed and runs on Cloudfla

item.title: [infoq] 四分之一PR是“AI垃圾”！Linux基金会发布新报告：AI写代码快了52%，开源维护者却更累了
item.description: A Linux Foundation report released Oct 20, “Navigating Open Source Software Development in the Generative AI Era,” sponsored by Red Hat, finds generative AI cut coding time by 52% on average. But maintainers estimate roughly 25% of incoming PRs are low-quality “AI slop,” rising to 31% on large projects, while 59% report more contributions overall. 21% of respondents say complex tasks actually take longer with AI.

item.title: [v2ex] [裁员] 如果你也经历过裁员，说说你的故事

He now builds products for overseas markets from Tanzania, and advises engineers to treat English and portable skills as spare doors.

item.title: [infoq] React 19.3 新增 browser() API，使“仅客户端渲染”成为一等公民
item.description: React 19.3, released to npm on September 9, adds a react-dom browser() API that lets components opt out of server rendering: use(browser()) suspends the component on the server, keeps the nearest Suspense fallback in the HTML, and returns undefined in the browser. It replaces mounted-flag and typeof-window workarounds for localStorage or timezone reads that caused hydration mismatches, and adds an onBrowserBailout callback reporting where rendering was skipped.

item.title: [infoq] 何时应使用 Liquid Clustering？湖仓布局策略基准测试
item.description: A benchmark on Delta Lake compares partitioning, ZOrdering and Liquid Clustering across 50 million records and four workload types. Liquid Clustering had the lowest latency for point queries, time-range aggregations and large aggregations, making it the sensible default for teams whose query patterns vary or keep changing. item.title: [github_trending] pbakaus/impeccable
item.description: Impeccable is a design guidance package for AI coding agents: one skill, 24 commands, live browser iteration and 62 deterministic detector rules, installed with npx impeccable install and initialized via /impeccable init. It builds on Anthropic's frontend-design skill and records product truth in PRODUCT.md to suppress the usual tells, such as Inter everywhere, purple-to-blue gradients and cards nested in cards. Useful for developers whose AI-written frontends all look alike.

It also covers JDK 28 Early Access Build 19 and GlassFish 8.0.5. Useful for teams planning around the JDK 28 upgrade.

item.title: [hackernews] We should be more ambitious with the software we build

The author acknowledges the widespread skepticism toward AI-generated projects, then notes that pgrust's testing is thorough enough to have surfaced real Postgres bugs, including SP-GiST numeric errors, a JSONPath format cache bug, pgcrypto failures and a money overflow. Relevant to anyone judging where AI-assisted work actually holds up

item.title: [hackernews] Docker is weird
item.description: The author built a container runtime for fun and wrote up what that exercise revealed about Docker's internals: containers are not miniature VMs but ordinary processes under restrictions, findable in /proc, and there is no single Linux "container" feature, just namespaces, cgroups and networking tricks layered together. Images, meanwhile, are essentially folders that Docker stores somewhere and then makes the process's root via chroot or pivot_root. Useful for anyone who wants to know what actua

item.title: [infoq] Cloudflare 的 OHTTP 网关拒绝解密通过 Cloudflare 传入的请求
item.description: Cloudflare has opened a closed beta of its OHTTP Gateway, a hosted endpoint that decrypts Oblivious HTTP (RFC 9458) requests on behalf of origin servers. The notable constraint: it refuses to decrypt traffic arriving through Cloudflare Workers or proxied hosts, since the relay hop that sees client IPs and the decrypting hop must be run by unrelated operators. Cloudflare ships no relay server; its older Privacy Gateway is now called OHTTP Relay.

JetBrains pitches it as adapting to your project the more you use it, with full extension support planned next. Aimed at developers who want agent-driven coding without leaving a real IDE.
